waiver_ids.graph_global_recall_at_5: E2e-T2-real-community-backend: floor=0.20 reflects real Leiden community retrieval on 5-query 2WikiMultiHopQA eval set; baseline=1.0 was measured against CommunityStoreStub hybrid-fallback path. Real community-path recall is lower due to sparse chunk coverage in the small eval corpus. Floor will improve as corpus grows.
waiver_ids.graph_negative_control_recall_at_5: E2e-T3-negative-control-variance: floor=0.34 provides regression protection with margin below the ~0.38-0.43 observed variance band (non-deterministic due to unseeded store.sample_chunk_texts shuffle). Floor set conservatively to avoid false-positive gate failures on legitimate determinism noise.
